narr: Showers and thunderstorms continued throughout the day as an upper trough lifted slowly northeast across the region. A very moist airmass with PWATs near the 99th percentile, supported heavy rainfall resulting in isolated flash flooding.
ev: Webb Town Rd near Arlan Reasons Rd near Cypress Creek were impassable. Additional roads flooded included Hwy 189 and Hwy 412.
